planning_anchors.source: Values frozen in the final design review; they are planning anchors, not current-commit deployment measurements.

action_compare_anchor.aggregation: median of convergence_check_ms_list values from prediction_step >= 2

scenarios.description: Uses frozen recurrent/decode anchors and the observed median comparison cost while setting candidate-only gate and finite-check costs to zero.
Mechanism-only sensitivity with every control-flow operation set to zero.
Stress test favorable to the candidate: comparison costs 0.5 ms while gate and finite checks remain free.
Low nonzero gate and finite-check sensitivity using the observed median comparison cost.
Moderate synchronization sensitivity; this is diagnostic rather than a measured cost model.

promotion_gate.interpretation: A linear replay estimate cannot promote a candidate online; an actual GPU schedule microbenchmark must still demonstrate at least this reduction.
